prompt: List of posts for home, board, tag and member pages.
shortDesc: List of posts as rows with votes, optionally for one board, tag or author, sorted hot (default), new, top or active. Takes only filters: it loads the posts itself. Use on the home page, /b/<board>, tag and profile pages.

props.name: board
props.description: Board id: general, show-and-tell, questions, ideas or off-topic.

props.name: author-id
props.description: Only posts by this member (user id).

styling.notes: Stack of g-post-row with 8px gaps; plain empty state.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'list posts', board?, sort, tag?, authorId?, limit, outputFormat: { posts: [{ id, boardId, title, author: { displayName }, createdAt, score, commentCount, myVote }] } }
